title: Portable smartphone enabled colorimetric detection of tetracycline in commercial milk samples via peroxidase-mimicking ZnO–Pd nanobolts
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2862-2872
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00428D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ekta Arjundas Kukreja, Ravi Mani Tripathi
An efficacious nanozyme, ZnO–Pd nanobolt, was utilised for fabricating a smart and robust assay for the detection of tetracycline with a LOD of 2.9 nM. It is based on a turn-off approach where the antibiotic competes with the chromogenic substrate.
